info.title: Real Command API
info.description: API-first interface of Real Command, a persistent real-time strategy game on the world map. Everything the web client can do is available here, so scripts and AI agents can build and run a base. Authenticate with the player token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (or `X-Token` header / `?token=`). Start with GET /rules and GET /catalog, then GET /me/situation.

Point.description: A position. Pass either x/y (metres, plate carrée) or lon/lat (degrees).

fireDiscipline.description: Own units only; defaults to free.

routeRepeat.description: Own units only. Route repeats as a patrol; one destination holds a watch post.

route.description: Own units only. Active destination first, then queued waypoints.

queued.description: move/attackmove only: append to an active route (at most 16 destinations including the current one); otherwise start a new route. Other orders replace the route, except fire.

repeat.description: move/attackmove only: repeat the route as a patrol. Queued points inherit this setting when omitted. New unqueued orders default to a one-time route. Unreachable points are removed; stop cancels the patrol.

mode.description: Required for k: fire. Does not cancel movement. Direct attack orders remain explicit.

x-websocket.description: The web client uses a WebSocket stream with the same commands (hello/spawn/order/produce/cancel/place/sell/repair/rally/chat) and receives state deltas at 5 Hz. See shared/protocol.ts.
